correctness.rationale: For every integer d>=1 and r>=2, the proof independently exhausts all prime factors (even prime impossible; unramified p|d; p∤d controlled by d²+3; ramified p=3 exactly once), establishes the length-three identity by distinct linear differences, and uses simple-root lifting plus CRT for all exact divisor probabilities. A translation obstruction in each prime-power channel proves the periods minimal. Direct independent finite checks covered 120000 two-point cases, 30000 longer-window cases, and complete frequencies and minimal periods for 73 shifts; computation is evidence, not the proof.

value.rationale: For the natural family of shifted third-cyclotomic values, the theorem closes the gap from generic resultant upper bounds to an explicit sharp period, maximal gcd, all attainable gcds and the exact measure of every fiber for all d. The first three terms of each arithmetic-progression window determine every longer gcd, and the second-to-third transition is quantified by disappearance of exactly the prime factors of d²+3. The simultaneous unbounded-parameter classification is substantively motivated by the cited polynomial-gcd periodicity program, not a table recomputation or cosmetic renaming.
